phase: Phase 7B — Contradiction Resolution & Independent Evidence Audit

contradiction_a_window_duration_and_samp.claimed_in_phase7: 3.0s window, 1000 radar samples @ 333.33Hz, 1500 ECG samples @ 500Hz, 44 windows/recording
contradiction_a_window_duration_and_samp.verified_source_code_truth: 10.0s window, 5.0s hop, 3333 radar samples/window, 1667 radar samples/hop, 5000 ECG samples/window, 22 complete windows/recording (48 recordings x 22 = 1056 candidate windows)

contradiction_b_kan_parameter_count.claimed_in_phase7: Single-layer KAN head 128->1 with 128 base + 1024 spline + 1 bias = 1153 params vs 1360 claimed, 1280 untrainable grid params
contradiction_b_kan_parameter_count.verified_source_code_truth: Two-layer KAN head (16->8->1): Layer 1 (16->8) = 1280 trainable params, Layer 2 (8->1) = 80 trainable params, total head = 1360 trainable params, 0 non-trainable params, grid is tf.constant buffer of shape (12,); Full KAN = 3360 backbone + 1360 head = 4720 params

contradiction_c_mlp_parameter_count.verified_source_code_truth: ConvFeatureExtractor backbone (3360 params) + 2-layer Dense head (16->8->1): Dense1 (16->8) = 136 params, Dense2 (8->1) = 9 params; head total = 145 params; full MLP = 3360 + 145 = 3505 params

contradiction_d_cnn_parameter_count.claimed_in_phase7: Standard 4-layer conv net downsampling to 128 totaling 3360 params (hypothetical architecture would be >60,000 params)
contradiction_d_cnn_parameter_count.verified_source_code_truth: 3-layer Conv1D downsampling from 3333 to 16 latent features: conv1 (128 params) -> conv2 (1424 params) -> conv3 (1808 params) = 3360 backbone params; readout Dense(16, 1) = 17 params; full CNN = 3377 params

contradiction_e_filter_causality.claimed_in_phase7: Filtering described as causal in executive summary and zero-phase filtfilt in technical audit
contradiction_e_filter_causality.verified_source_code_truth: Strictly non-causal zero-phase 4th-order Butterworth bandpass (0.8-3.0 Hz) using scipy.signal.filtfilt on entire 120s recording before windowing; future samples influence current output; valid for retrospective study, unsuitable for real-time streaming without causal IIR adaptation

contradiction_f_synthetic_test_failure_a.claimed_in_phase7: Phase 7 executive reported 87.5% within 5 BPM; detailed investigation reported 68.8% for 10 epochs seed 42; 75% mentioned elsewhere
contradiction_f_synthetic_test_failure_a.verified_source_code_truth: Sample quantization on N=16 test samples yields a discrete 6.25% lattice (11/16=68.75%, 12/16=75.0%, 14/16=87.5%, 16/16=100.0%); meeting >=90% requires >=15/16 (93.75%); CPU thread non-determinism and 10-epoch unconverged basin explain variance; at 15 epochs, optimizer reaches asymptotic convergence (MAE 0.45-1.18 BPM, 100.0% within 5 BPM)

known_limitations.description: Hardware synchronization between radar FMCW transceiver and medical ECG monitor lacks common electronic triggers; nominal T0=0 operational convention is assumed.
Filtering is non-causal zero-phase forward-backward filtfilt on continuous recordings; valid for retrospective ML benchmark, but real-time streaming requires causal IIR or FIR filter redesign.
Integration test on N=16 synthetic samples has coarse 6.25% discrete quantization; future test suites should verify software invariants rather than strict stochastic thresholds.
